title: Finding Audio Clips
summary: Go to creative commons search https://search.creativecommons.org/ Choose platform Soundcloud or ccMixter Choose embed, Copy code. If you want to download without signing in try ccmixter
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
1. Go to creative commons search https://search.creativecommons.org/
  2. Choose platform Soundcloud or ccMixter
  3. Choose embed,
  4. Copy code.
  5. If you want to download without signing in try ccmixter
